messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.

Translate literally: Alla mína ævi hef ég farið til Gjögurs á sumrin. Það er eitthvað ólýsanlegt við það að fara í sveitina, slökkva á öllum áreitinu úr símanum og tengjast ósnertri náttúrunni í sveitinni.

message.content: All my life I have gone to Gjögur in the summer. There is something inexplicable about going to the camp, turning off all notifications from the phone, and connecting with the unspoiled nature in the camp.
